screen26-a1.description: top of the left server rail
screen26-a1.visible_text: none (speech-bubble glyph at top of the rail)
screen26-a1.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Direct Messages"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
screen26-a1.convention_relied_on: speech bubble = messages/chat; my reading, confidence high
screen26-a1.initial_rationale: unlabeled speech bubble is the messaging convention; exemption pending the tap

test_cases.action: tap the speech bubble at the top of the rail
test_cases.confirms_if: it opens something other than messages

screen26-a1.deciding_evidence: the speech bubble opened the Messages view, matching the chat convention

screen26-a2.description: server name heading with a right chevron
screen26-a2.visible_text: "Accessibility Testin's server" with a right chevron (styled as the page heading)
screen26-a2.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Accessibility Testin's server"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
screen26-a2.initial_rationale: styled as a title; only a small chevron hints it is pressable, and nothing says what it opens

test_cases.expected_result: if the heading is a title, nothing; if the chevron means 'more', a detail view
test_cases.confirms_if: a menu of unrelated actions opens that the title did not predict
test_cases.overturns_if: a clearly server-info view opens that the title predicted
test_cases.observed_result: a bottom sheet opened with the server tile, '1 Online · 1 Member', Boost/Invite/Notifications/Settings icons, 'Mark As Read', 'Create Channel', 'Create Category', 'Create Event', 'Edit Per-server Profile' and toggles

screen26-a2.deciding_evidence: a heading that reads as the page title opened a large server actions menu; nothing on the heading says it is a menu or what it holds
screen26-a2.recommendation: add a visible cue such as 'Server menu' or a gear/menu glyph with a caption beside the name, or move the menu to a labeled button

screen26-a3.initial_rationale: the word and glyph say search

test_cases.observed_result: a search view opened with field placeholder "Search in Accessibility Testin's server" and tabs Recent/Members/Channels/Media/Pins/Links

screen26-a3.deciding_evidence: the Search pill opened a server search view

screen26-a6.visible_text: "ATs" (initials on a rounded tile; three identical tiles in the rail)
screen26-a6.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Accessibility Testin's server"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
screen26-a6.initial_rationale: three tiles carry the identical abbreviation 'ATs' and nothing else; a first-time user cannot tell what the tiles are or tell them apart
screen26-a6.deciding_evidence: carried from screen1-a5 (same control, tested once): identical 'ATs' tiles lead to identically named, identically laid-out servers; nothing visible says what a tile is or which is which
screen26-a6.recommendation: show the full server name under or beside each tile (and a 'Servers' caption on the rail); give each server a distinct visible name or icon

screen26-a7.description: row with a shield-like glyph and the words 'Server Boosts'
screen26-a7.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Server Boosts"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
screen26-a7.initial_rationale: 'Boosts' is product jargon; a first-time user cannot tell what a boost is or that it involves paying

test_cases.expected_result: an explanation of what boosting is, before any commitment
test_cases.confirms_if: a perks/purchase page opens without first saying what a boost is in plain words
test_cases.overturns_if: a plain explanation that the words predicted opens
test_cases.observed_result: a 'Server Boosts' page opened: 0 Available/Spent/Total, Level 1 (2 Boosts) and Level 2 (5 Boosts) perk cards, Additional Perks, and a 'Boost This Server' button

screen26-a7.deciding_evidence: the row opened a perk-level page with a 'Boost This Server' call to action; the label never conveyed that boosts are a paid upgrade
screen26-a7.recommendation: label it in plain words, e.g. 'Upgrade this server (paid)', with a one-line caption saying what boosting unlocks
